convention: errors-count-as-wrong-at-all-levels/v1: FILE, FUNCTION, and LINE share the same denominator (n = all loaded records); engine errors and git_show failures count as WRONG and are reported separately (*_counted_wrong / n_engine_errors keys).

source.pipeline: shipped roust-rs engine, --budget 8192, confidence-scheduled packing (parity/region_eval_full.py Part A, no-LLM), FULL SWE-bench test split (paper eval wave)

file_correct_subset.note: restricted to instances where FILE-level was already correct -- isolates region/line/function quality from file recall

agentless_note: AGENTLESS_GPT4O numbers are Agentless's published SWE-bench LITE localization rates (arXiv:2407.01489 Table 1) -- context only; no published Agentless full-split localization numbers exist to compare against directly.
